description: Regular-expression matching of a string value against a pattern supplied as a regular-expression source string. The positive relation is satisfied when the pattern matches the actual string and reports a violation otherwise; the negated relation is satisfied when the pattern does NOT match and reports a violation when it does. A violation diagnostic renders the actual string and the pattern in slash-delimited form. The actual value must be a string; when it is not, the request is rejected with a neutral error category.

cases.expected_output:
check=not_match
outcome=violation
message=Expected 'actual' to not match /^actual$/
